text: Female, likely late teens to early twenties. Lean build, pale skin. Long, flowing red hair cascades down back and shoulders. Oval face with high cheekbones, sharp jawline. Gold eyes, dark eyeliner, full lips. Wears a sheer light blue gown with deep V-neck, thin straps, and draped fabric pooling at feet. Blue teardrop earrings, choker necklace with large pendant. Standing front-facing, arms slightly outstretched. Other panels show side/back views and facial close-ups.
